collection.output: summary.json contains the JSON emitted by the collection script; individual gate stdout/stderr/commands are saved in case subdirectories.
collection.meaning: Exit 0 means collection and preservation assertions completed, not that every proposed rejection occurred. I04 expected rejection did not occur and is retained.
collection.stdout_transcript_status: Reconstructed verbatim text transcript from the observed tool stdout JSON and identical summary.json; not a separately captured raw stdout stream and no independent raw-byte hash claim.
